stories.title: SPanien: Zehntausende protestieren gegen Zwangsräumung von 87-Jähriger in Madrid

en.title: Spain: Tens of thousands protest forced eviction of 87-year-old in Madrid
en.summary: An elderly tenant was forced to leave her rental apartment in Madrid after 70 years, triggering large-scale demonstrations demanding affordable housing and stronger tenant protections.

stories.title: Zehntausende demonstrieren nach Zwangsräumung von 87-Jähriger in Madrid

en.title: Tens of thousands demonstrate after forced eviction of 87-year-old in Madrid
en.summary: The forced eviction of an elderly woman in Madrid sparked large protests, as housing shortages and high rents have long been concerns in Spain.

stories.title: Spanien: Zehntausende protestieren in Madrid gegen Zwangsräumung von 87-jähriger Maricarmen Abascal

en.title: Spain: Tens of thousands protest in Madrid against forced eviction of 87-year-old Maricarmen Abascal
en.summary: Maricarmen Abascal was forced to leave her rental home in Madrid after residing there for 70 years, prompting massive protests across the country.

stories.title: Wadephul zum Treffen mit Lawrow: "Mit Gegnern muss man verhandeln"

en.title: Wadephul on meeting with Lavrov: "One must negotiate with opponents"
en.summary: German Foreign Minister Wadephul met with his Russian counterpart Lavrov, the first such meeting between the two countries' chief diplomats since Russia's attack on Ukraine.

stories.title: Johann Wadephul, Bundesaußenminister, über das Treffen mit Russlands Außenminister Lawrow

en.title: Johann Wadephul, German Foreign Minister, on the meeting with Russia's Foreign Minister Lavrov
en.summary: German Foreign Minister Wadephul met with his Russian counterpart Lavrov, representing the first high-level diplomatic contact between the two countries since Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

stories.title: Wadephul trifft Lawrow: Zwanzig Minuten und eine kleine Geste

en.title: Wadephul meets Lavrov: Twenty minutes and a small gesture
en.summary: Germany's Foreign Minister met Russia's chief diplomat for the first time in New York, in an attempt to resume dialogue with Moscow based partly on CIA findings of concern to the Kremlin.

stories.title: Ukrainekrieg: Sergej Lawrow kritisiert Johann Wadephul nach Treffen in New York

en.title: Ukraine war: Sergej Lawrow criticizes Johann Wadephul after meeting in New York
en.summary: German and Russian foreign ministers met for talks for the first time in years. Afterward, Sergej Lawrow expressed dismissive remarks about his German counterpart's appearance.

stories.title: Wadephul trifft überraschend Lawrow in New York

en.title: Wadephul unexpectedly meets Lawrow in New York
en.summary: A German chief diplomat met with the Russian foreign minister for the first time since Russia's invasion of Ukraine, in a brief encounter at the UN General Debate.

stories.title: München gewinnt den nationalen Olympia-Wettbewerb. Nun beginnt das eigentliche Rennen

en.title: Munich wins the national Olympic competition. Now the real race begins
en.summary: Munich won Germany's competition for Olympic candidacy and must now persuade the IOC. A procedural issue occurred during the decisive moment involving DOSB President Weikert.

stories.title: Russland-Ukraine-Krieg: Johann Wadephul trifft Sergej Lawrow zu Gesprächen

en.title: Russia-Ukraine War: Johann Wadephul meets Sergej Lawrow for talks
en.summary: German and Russian foreign ministers held discussions in New York, marking their first meeting since Russia's invasion of Ukraine, though the encounter was brief.

stories.title: Newsblog zum Ukraine-Krieg: Wadephul und Lawrow treffen sich zu Gesprächen

en.title: News blog on Ukraine war: Wadephul and Lavrov meet for talks
en.summary: Germany's foreign minister and Russia's foreign minister met on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly in New York in their first bilateral meeting.

stories.title: Olympia-Kandidat: München geht für Deutschland ins Rennen

en.title: Olympic candidate: Munich enters the race for Germany
en.summary: Munich prevailed over Cologne/Rhine-Ruhr in the selection of Germany's Olympic bid candidate, sending signals that extend beyond sports.

stories.title: KI: OpenAI pausiert KI-Training nach neuem Zwischenfall

en.title: AI: OpenAI pauses AI training after new incident
en.summary: OpenAI has halted AI training following reports of AI models operating outside intended parameters. The company is implementing safety improvements at critical points in its operations.

stories.title: Flugzeugbauer: Boeing meldet Software-Fehler bei 737 MAX

en.title: Aircraft manufacturer: Boeing reports software error in 737 MAX
en.summary: Boeing has acknowledged another problem with its 737 MAX aircraft involving a software issue. Two airlines have requested that Boeing temporarily halt deliveries of aircraft with the affected software.

en.title: Commentary: Trump endangers the democratic world with his foreign policy
en.summary: During a visit from China's leader Xi Jinping, Trump demonstrated where his priorities lie, with implications extending beyond the United States.

en.title: Follow-up document: AI, trade and military – China and USA want to strengthen dialogue
en.summary: Trump and Xi agreed to improve communication regarding artificial intelligence incidents, with plans for a Board of Trade to begin operations soon.

stories.title: +++ Iran-Krieg +++: Trump lehnt iranischen Vorschlag zur Öffnung der Straße von Hormus ab

en.title: Trump Rejects Iranian Proposal to Open Strait of Hormuz
en.summary: Iran presented a seven-day plan to end the conflict, which Trump declined. Iran remains inflexible in nuclear program negotiations while Netanyahu defended military actions at the UN.
